auth.description:
Connect your PostHog account.

**Personal API Key**: Go to PostHog → Settings → Personal API Keys → Create personal API key.

**Project ID**: Found in the URL when viewing your project: `/project/{id}/`

**API Host**: The base URL for private API calls.
- US Cloud (default): `https://us.posthog.com`
- EU Cloud: `https://eu.posthog.com`
- Self-hosted: your instance URL (e.g. `https://posthog.mycompany.com`)

**Ingestion Host**: The base URL for event capture.
- US Cloud (default): `https://us.i.posthog.com`
- EU Cloud: `https://eu.i.posthog.com`
- Self-hosted: same as your API Host

project_id.description: Your PostHog project ID (found in project settings URL)

api_host.description: Base URL for private API calls (default: https://us.posthog.com)

ingestion_host.description: Base URL for event capture (default: https://us.i.posthog.com)

create_event.name: create_event
create_event.description: Capture a custom event in PostHog

event.description: The name of the event to capture

distinct_id.description: Unique identifier for the user performing the action (e.g. user ID or email address)

properties.description: Additional event properties as key/value pairs

aiMetadata.description: Sends a custom analytics event to PostHog attributed to a user via their distinct ID (e.g. user ID or email), with optional event properties. Use to record a product action or behavior in PostHog. Not idempotent: each call appends a new event, so repeating it records duplicate events.

create_project.name: create_project
create_project.description: Create a new PostHog project in your organization

organization_id.description: The organization to create the project in

name.description: The name of the new project

anonymize_ips.description: Whether to anonymize incoming IP addresses

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new project within a chosen PostHog organization, optionally anonymizing incoming IP addresses. Use when provisioning a fresh analytics project. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate project even with the same name.

get_feature_flags.name: get_feature_flags
get_feature_flags.description: List all feature flags in your PostHog project

limit.description: Maximum number of feature flags to return (default: 100)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves feature flags defined in the connected PostHog project, including each flag key, name, and active state, with an optional result limit. Use to inspect or audit which feature flags exist. Idempotent: a read-only lookup with no side effects.

list_persons.name: list_persons
list_persons.description: Get a list of identified users in your PostHog project

limit.description: Maximum number of persons to return (default: 100)

search.description: Filter persons by email or name

aiMetadata.description: Lists identified users (persons) in the connected PostHog project; with an empty search it returns all persons up to the limit, or pass a search string to filter by email or name. Use to look up users or find a specific person before acting on them. Idempotent: a read-only lookup with no side effects.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
